text: This report provides the Audit Results, as prepared by KPMG, to assist the Board in reviewing the financial statement for the year ended December 31, 2024. The Audit Results Report was reviewed and discussed at the Policy and Finance Committee meeting on May 13, 2025.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Received the report (May 23, 2025) from the Chief Transformation Officer, Toronto Zoo for information. 2. Recommended that City Council receive for information the Toronto Zoo 2024 Audit Results and Financial Statements.
